title: Creative Writing
tagline: Read like a writer, write every week, and finish a manuscript you are proud of.
overview:
The Certificate in Creative Writing is a three-year course of study in the craft of fiction, poetry, and creative nonfiction. You begin by writing in all three genres while learning to read published work for technique, then build core skills in character, structure, imagery, form, dialogue, and revision through a sequence of workshops.

As you advance you write for stage and screen, explore genre and experimental forms, plan a book-length project, and learn how writers publish and sustain their careers. In your final year you choose a concentration in fiction, poetry, or creative nonfiction, and complete a two-term thesis manuscript.
outcomes: Write accomplished fiction, poetry, and creative nonfiction using the tools of each genre.
Read published work as a writer, identifying and adapting technique.
Revise substantially, at the level of structure as well as the sentence.
Give and use critical feedback in a workshop community.
Plan, draft, and complete a sustained manuscript.
Navigate the practical world of submissions, editing, and publication.
